entry.title: Deep Learning Framework for Automated Orthodontic Treatment Planning Using 3D Dental Models
entry.summary: We present a novel deep learning framework for automated orthodontic treatment planning that leverages 3D dental model analysis. Our approach combines graph neural networks with attention mechanisms to predict optimal tooth movements. Evaluated on a dataset of 1,200 cases, the system achieves 94.2% agreement with expert orthodontists on treatment staging decisions.

entry.title: CephaloNet: Attention-Based Cephalometric Landmark Detection with Sub-Millimeter Accuracy
entry.summary: We introduce CephaloNet, a novel attention-based architecture for cephalometric landmark detection in lateral skull radiographs. The model utilizes a hierarchical feature pyramid network combined with spatial attention modules to achieve sub-millimeter accuracy. On the ISBI 2015 challenge dataset, CephaloNet achieves a mean radial error of 1.12mm, establishing a new state of the art.

entry.title: Biomechanical Simulation of Tooth Movement Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
entry.summary: This paper proposes a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach for simulating orthodontic tooth movement. By incorporating periodontal ligament mechanics and alveolar bone remodeling into the loss function, our model predicts tooth displacement trajectories with 89% correlation to clinical outcomes. The approach reduces simulation time from hours to seconds compared to traditional FEM methods.
